collision_check: All four names checked against existing prop-*.fbx under the studio art tree before export: none taken. Distinct from prop-grindstone-small-cu1, grindstone-dresser set, prop-hone-stone-blank, feed/kneading/slaking/wood troughs, prop-water-drip-cup-gs1, prop-axle-tree-blank and prop-crank-handle-blank (gf1 versions are grindstone-specific and sized for it).
judgment_calls: A-frame uses 4 legs + 2 stretchers (72 tris); bearing blocks omitted to stay under the 80 tri preference.
Trough is a single inset block with no flat rim (20 tris).
Crank grip is wood, arm is iron (two material slots).
Textures are flat 64x64 BaseColor PNGs; materials use plain colour values, no image nodes in the shipped files.

assets.name: prop-grindstone-aframe-blank-gf1
assets.desc: Wooden grindstone stand blank: two A-shaped trestle ends (each two 6 cm square slanted legs meeting at a ~0.76 m apex where an axle would rest), joined by two 5 cm square low stretchers at 0.22 m running between the A-ends. No wheel, no bearing blocks.

assets.name: prop-grindstone-axle-blank-gf1
assets.desc: Plain iron axle rod blank: 0.60 m hexagonal bar, 4 cm across, lying along X, flat-capped ends.

assets.name: prop-grindstone-trough-blank-gf1
assets.desc: Shallow wooden water trough blank, 0.50 x 0.26 x 0.10 m single hollowed block: sunk 7 cm basin with slightly sloped inner walls meeting the outer top edge (no flat rim), 3 cm solid base.

assets.name: prop-grindstone-crank-gf1
assets.desc: Short crank handle blank: flat iron arm 0.18 x 0.03 x 0.015 m with an upright 10 cm hexagonal oak grip (3.2 cm across) standing on one end.
